headlines.title_en: Morning news roundup
headlines.summary_en: The STAR 50 Index rose 4.5% in the half-day session, the ChiNext Index rose over 2%, and computing power hardware and semiconductor sectors strengthened collectively. The Hang Seng Index rose 0.12% in the half-day session, the Hang Seng Tech Index rose 0.87%, Zhipu surged over 8%, and Hua Hong Semiconductor and Lenovo rose over 7%. Hong Kong releases its first five-year plan: focusing on the artificial intelligence industry and strengthening its function as the world's largest offshore RMB hub. PBOC Governor Pan Gongsheng: Credit growth alone cannot be simply used to measure the strength of financial support for the real economy. China's Pinglu Canal is officially completed and open to navigation, capable of accommodating 5,000-tonne vessels.

headlines.title: 潘功胜：不能简单以信贷增速衡量金融支持实体经济的力度
headlines.summary: 《求是》刊发央行行长潘功胜的署名文章，题为《深刻认识中国金融结构变迁提升金融服务实体经济适配性》。其中指出，当前科技创新活动复杂多元，与多元化的融资结构更加适配。科技型企业一般会经历种子期、初创期、成长期、成熟期等不同阶段，各阶段的风险特征和金融需求有很大差异，需要适配丰富多样的金融市场和金融生态。科技型企业在成长的早期，主要从事前期研发，商业前景不明朗，私募股权和创业投资是非常重要的资金提供者。到了中后期，商业模式逐渐成熟，可以通过银行贷款、债券、股权等多渠道融资。金融市场在为技术前沿、高风险高回报的创新产业提供融资上具有优势，带来对贷款的良性替代和分

headlines.title_en: Pan Gongsheng: Credit growth alone cannot simply be used to gauge the strength of financial support for the real economy
headlines.summary_en: Qiushi published a signed article by PBOC Governor Pan Gongsheng titled "Deeply Understanding the Changes in China's Financial Structure and Improving the Adaptability of Financial Services to the Real Economy." It pointed out that current technological innovation activities are complex and diverse, and are better matched to diversified financing structures. Technology-based enterprises generally go through different stages such as seed stage, startup stage, growth stage and maturity stage, and the risk characteristics and financial needs of each stage differ greatly, requiring a rich and varied financial market and financial ecosystem. In the early stages of growth, technology-based enterprises mainly engage in early-stage research and development, with unclear commercial prospects, and private equity and venture capital are very important providers of funds. In the middle and later stages, as business models gradually mature, financing can be obtained through multiple channels such as bank loans, bonds and equity. headlines.title: 潘功胜：持续推进货币政策框架转型，构建科学稳健的货币政策体系
headlines.summary: 《求是》刊发央行行长潘功胜的署名文章，题为《深刻认识中国金融结构变迁提升金融服务实体经济适配性》。其中指出，持续推进货币政策框架转型，构建科学稳健的货币政策体系。不断优化货币政策中间变量，淡化对数量目标的关注，特别是对贷款单一渠道的关注，把金融总量更多作为观测性、参考性、预期性指标。更加注重发挥价格型调控的作用，健全市场化的利率形成、调控和传导机制。完善短端利率调控机制，进一步优化完善政策利率及配套制度建设，增强央行政策利率的作用。完善存贷款利率定价，为经营主体提供更多的贷款定价基准选择。加强利率政策执行和监督，持续整治金融业“内卷式”竞争、资金空转。健

headlines.title_en: Pan Gongsheng: Continue to advance the transformation of the monetary policy framework and build a scientific and稳健 monetary policy system
headlines.summary_en: Qiushi published a signed article by PBOC Governor Pan Gongsheng titled "Deeply Understanding the Changes in China's Financial Structure and Improving the Adaptability of Financial Services to the Real Economy." It pointed out that the transformation of the monetary policy framework should be continuously advanced to build a scientific and robust monetary policy system. Continuously optimize intermediate variables of monetary policy, dilute attention to quantitative targets, especially attention to a single channel such as loans, and take financial aggregates more as observational, reference and expectation indicators. Pay more attention to the role of price-based regulation and improve the market-based interest rate formation, regulation and transmission mechanism. Improve the short-end interest rate regulation mechanism, further optimize and improve the policy interest rate and supporting institutional arrangements, and enhance the role of the central bank's policy interest rate. Improve the pricing of deposit and lending rates and provide more loan pricing benchmark choices for business entities. headlines.title: 潘功胜：丰富宏观审慎管理的工具箱，维护股市、债市、汇市等金融市场平稳运行
headlines.summary: 《求是》刊发央行行长潘功胜的署名文章，其中提到，健全覆盖全面的宏观审慎管理体系，进一步提升金融体系的稳定性和韧性。在宏观层面把握好经济增长、经济结构调整和金融风险防范的动态平衡。稳妥化解重点领域风险。继续做好金融支持地方政府融资平台债务风险化解工作。稳妥有序推进重点地区和重点机构风险化解，严肃财经纪律、市场纪律和监管规则。健全金融稳定保障体系。强化系统性金融风险的监测、评估和预警。拓展中央银行宏观审慎和金融稳定功能，丰富宏观审慎管理的工具箱，维护股市、债市、汇市等金融市场平稳运行。

headlines.title_en: Pan Gongsheng: Enrich the macroprudential management toolbox and maintain the stable operation of financial markets including the stock, bond and foreign exchange markets
headlines.summary_en: Qiushi published a signed article by PBOC Governor Pan Gongsheng, which mentioned that a comprehensive macroprudential management system should be improved to further enhance the stability and resilience of the financial system. At the macro level, maintain a dynamic balance among economic growth, economic structural adjustment and financial risk prevention. Steadily defuse risks in key areas. Continue to do a good job in financial support for defusing debt risks of local government financing platforms. Steadily and orderly advance risk resolution in key regions and key institutions, and strictly enforce fiscal discipline, market discipline and regulatory rules. Improve the financial stability guarantee system. Strengthen the monitoring, assessment and early warning of systemic financial risks. Expand the central bank's macroprudential and financial stability functions, enrich the toolbox of macroprudential management, and maintain the smooth operation of financial markets such as the stock market, bond market and foreign exchange market.

headlines.title: China’s inbound tourism revenue projected to reach US$470 billion by 2040: UBS
headlines.summary:
Revenue from inbound travel to China is forecast to reach US$470 billion by 2040, more than doubling its current share of the economy and helping offset weak domestic demand, according to UBS.
Tourism from outside mainland China would expand to 1.5 per cent of gross domestic product (GDP) on a compound annual growth rate of 8.9 per cent from 2025, the Swiss investment bank estimated.

headlines.title_zh: 瑞银：预计到2040年中国入境旅游收入将达到4700亿美元
headlines.summary_zh:
瑞银预计，到2040年，中国入境旅游收入将达4700亿美元，占经济比重较当前水平翻倍以上，有助于抵消国内需求疲软。

headlines.title_en: Economist: The Fed should withstand Trump's pressure to raise interest rates
headlines.summary_en: Top economists said the Federal Reserve should withstand pressure from Trump and raise interest rates for the first time in more than three years, supporting Federal Reserve Chairman Warsh's view that the central bank must focus on curbing inflation. Of 51 economists surveyed by the University of Chicago Booth School of Business, 50 said borrowing costs should be raised from the current 3.5%-3.75% range. Although most economists supported a 25-basis-point rate hike, 14% called for a substantial 50-basis-point hike due to concerns that the surge in fuel prices caused by Trump's war with Tehran will evolve into a broader inflation crisis. Olivier Coibion, a professor at the University of Texas at Austin, said: "The Federal Reserve is seriously behind the curve in raising interest rates. Semiconductor chip stocks rallied, with GRITEK, Jingsheng Mechanical & Electrical, Zhongjing Technology and Youyan New Material hitting the limit-up. Carbon black concept stocks surged, with Longxing Technology and Black Cat hit the limit-up. On the downside, the tourism sector fell, with Guilin Tourism hitting the limit-down. More stocks rose than fell, with nearly 4,200 stocks in the Shanghai, Shenzhen and Beijing markets gaining, and half-day turnover of RMB 1.17 trillion.
